input.quote: The common enterprise between and among the Parties shall be limited to the express provisions of this Agreement. The liability of the Parties shall be several and not joint or collective.
input.rationale: The liability regime is built from §21.1 (several and not joint liability), §4.9 (PG members not liable for Supplier/Wet Segment performance and no representations or warranties) and §21.2 (mutual third-party cross-indemnity limited to each Party's Schedule B share), with §32.2 requiring Management Committee approval before admitting liability. Nowhere does the Agreement impose an aggregate monetary cap on liability or exclude indirect/consequential damages, so our liability to the other APCN 2 Parties is unlimited in amount — a material failure of the fallback (mutual cap based on 12 months of fees with carve-outs for indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence and wilful misconduct). The several-not-joint allocation and the Schedule B share limit on indemnity contributions benefit us and are preserved untouched. We therefore add a single new Subparagraph 21.3 at the fallback level only: a mutual cap of twelve months' fees and charges, with indemnification under §21.2, breach of the Paragraph 31 confidentiality obligations, gross negligence and wilful misconduct expressly uncapped. We have not volunteered the preferred USD 1,000,000 floor, consequential-damages exclusion or additional carve-outs.

ops.text: 21.3 Except in respect of a Party's indemnification obligations under Subparagraph 21.2, its breach of Paragraph 31, its gross negligence or its wilful misconduct, which are not subject to any limit, each Party's aggregate liability to each other Party arising out of or in connection with this Agreement shall not exceed the fees and charges paid or payable by that Party under this Agreement in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement has no aggregate liability cap, so we added a mutual cap of twelve months' fees and charges, with indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence and wilful misconduct left uncapped. This is our fallback position.
proposal.summary: Insert mutual 12-month fees liability cap with carve-outs after §21.2

mappings.element: The aggregate liability cap applies mutually to both parties.
The cap is based on 12 months of fees.
Breach of confidentiality obligations is uncapped.
